verdict.rationale: Docs mention running agents step-by-step for long-running tool calls and replaying agent memory, hinting at manual state stepping, but there is no documented mechanism for persisting/restoring agent state across process restarts or deploys, nor any integration with durable-execution frameworks (e.g., Temporal, Restate). missing for 10: native state serialization/checkpointing, crash-recovery across restarts, and durable-execution framework integrations.
